We Need More Burgeres
by Srepic
WHAT THE FLIP THIS GAME IS ABOUT
Spoiler
We Need More Burgers is a game that I have been working on since January 1st, when I bought RPG Maker XP. My friend and I started working on projects and learning how to use RPG Maker XP. Now, I’m trying to make a full-fledged game.
Jamieson, who lives in a remote area away from society, is in dire need of a woman, luckily, Tom Pewterschmidt is somehow there to help. Jamieson shows Tom the way to town through his firewood storage tent and jamieson immediately finds a beautiful woman in town
My plan for the gameplay so far is that you will help people with various tasks, and there will be many different things to interact with, which can change elements of the game, sometimes leading to completely different scenes. I’d appreciate some feedback on the gameplay and whatnot.

posts.author: TRIDIUM
posts.body:
Just some feedback based on your screenshots and thread.
The lack of proper capitalization, punctuation, and grammar present in every text box you show, as well as some of the content of the thread itself, is a major turnoff.
That doesn't mean your characters have to use proper grammar, but the capitalization and punctuation should be used correctly. (Unless you're doing some sort of meta game)
Also, your "story" overview doesn't really tell me anything about the game, rather why you made it and the way the story will be presented. Those are fine things to share, but I'd add more info as to what the characters are doing, or what the world is like.
